case.interpretation: For the retrospective pool of final-ranked teams, a qualifying source version authored by its final team leader and created before April 23 documents that the leader already held a working predictor. With the additional planning assumption that this demonstrates possession of a usable method and that two candidates are drawn independently from this pool, the fraction supplies a conservative readiness floor. Unmatched, later, and non-leader-authored versions do not establish non-readiness. Thresholds are analyst-specified, not the official VFOLD sharing criterion. SubmissionDate is a re-evaluation date and is not used as the creation clock. This does not estimate q or research efficiency ratios.

studies.objective: Minimize the largest expected-time ratio relative to one no-bonus attribution rule that induces release throughout the same finite scenario set. Attribution is one common share across scenarios, rounded upward in 0.1-percentage-point increments to give strict incentives. All 51 bonus levels ($50 increments) are enumerated for both accounting rules. This is the best policy on the specified finite scenario set and bonus menu, not an optimum over a continuous uncertainty box or unrestricted contracts.
